YB NAVLOG

CROSS COUNTRY PLANNER

Guide

Work through the sections from top to bottom, one at a time — that's the fastest way to build a complete VFR cross-country plan without getting lost.

  • The header's Diagram icon shows how the input values relate to each other (click it to open) — Pink = POH, Blue = Weather, Purple = Compute, matching the tooltip colors.
  • Tooltips — P check the POH (written against the PA-28-161), W pull the value from weather sources, C a value you need to compute yourself (usually with a CX-3 or E6B).
  • Click SAMPLE in the header to see a filled-in example, or the eraser icon to clear everything.
  • Every section has a document icon next to its header — click it for a detailed guide on how to use that section.
  • Data storage — there's no permanent save, so you could lose everything you've entered. To keep a plan, use the export icon to save it as a file on your device, and the import icon to load a saved file back in.

PPOH 5-19 Climb Performance

*required: Cruise OAT/PA On-course Checkpoint

  • 3–5 NM from Departure
  • Climb FPM * ETE → ALT

PPOH 5-20 Fuel, Time and Distance to Climb

*required: Cruise OAT/PA, Departure OAT/PA ToC (Top of Climb)

  • Climb TAS: 79 kts

CDistance: (Alt to Lose / 1000) × 3 NM ToD (Top of Descent)

  • Descend TAS: 90 kts
  • 3° Descent: GS × 5 fpm → 1,000 ft per 3 NM
  • Distance: (Alt to Lose / 1000) × 3 NM
  • Alt to lose: Cruise ALT − TPA

BoD (Bottom of Descent)

  • Target altitude: TPA
  • 3–4 NM from Destination
